mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, total_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, status, payment_method, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, coupon_id, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{paymentMethod}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{couponId}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, pay_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
